question: At what wavelengths are the CD peaks of the D-HGNRs?

trace.query: SELECT id, text FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%D-HGNR%' AND (text ILIKE '%nm%' OR text ILIKE '%peak%') LIMIT 40
SELECT id, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (3,4) AND (text ILIKE '%nm%' OR text ILIKE '%CD%' OR text ILIKE '%mirror%') LIMIT 40
SELECT id, text, ocr_confirmed, strength FROM figure_facts f JOIN atoms a USING(id) WHERE figure_id='p4.F1' AND fact_no BETWEEN 5 AND 12
SELECT id, text FROM lines WHERE page=3 AND line_no BETWEEN 64 AND 70

rendered: According to the text, L- and D-HGNRs give mirror-image CD responses with distinct chiroptical peaks at 585 nm and 790 nm[1] (Fig. 1[2], panel c). A vision model's reading of the plotted D-HGNR curve gives slightly different positions, which are estimates: a positive peak near[3] 592 nm[4] and a negative band near 830 nm[5]. The values reported in the text should be used.
